review: PR302 first fresh adversarial whole-preprint and portable-package review

nonmandatory_suggestions.reason: The opening refers to unbundled CRITERIA.md, although the exact alternative result and its proof are present in the bundled notes.
nonmandatory_suggestions.repair: Replace the reference with the exact bundled alternative conclusion: measurable almost-sure C1(D-bar) recovery of S and mu, uniform recovery of actual div S, and global L2 recovery of S.

nonmandatory_suggestions.reason: Bruce Hansen(2008), Theorem3 is correctly applicable but bibliographically incomplete and absent from the source-edition table. A direct included covariance argument already proves the required statistical ingredient.
nonmandatory_suggestions.repair: Add Bruce E. Hansen, Uniform convergence rates for kernel estimation with dependent data, Econometric Theory24(2008)726-748, DOI10.1017/S0266466608080304, https://users.ssc.wisc.edu/~behansen/papers/et_08.pdf, plus inspected body/Theorem3/Assumptions2-3 source-edition entry.

nonmandatory_suggestions.reason: K_h is explicitly defined only for sampled z in D while state space is D-bar. Stationarity gives no boundary observations at the countably many fixed times almost surely, so the omission is a null-set definition issue rather than an asymptotic proof gap.
nonmandatory_suggestions.repair: Define K_h(x,z)=0 for z in boundary D, preserving Borel statistics for every D-bar sample, and state the stationary fixed-time boundary probability-zero argument.

nonmandatory_suggestions.reason: The written 0<eta<s-d/2-2 range can exceed the conventional C^{2,eta} Hölder range when s is large. The proof needs only one smaller positive exponent, already guaranteed by its strict Sobolev assumption.
nonmandatory_suggestions.origin: ROOT precision suggestion independently checked by this reviewer

strongest_verified_result: Almost-sure consistency of the specified all-positive-mode finite-rank spectral-equation fit in the explicit smooth stationary reversible conormal fixed-positive-lag model with known domain and pointwise bounds: local uniform S and separately fitted div S, C2 density, clipped global L2 S, and all-N dyadic extension. Separately, the alternative forward-kernel Hs regularization estimator converges almost surely in C1(D-bar).
